conclusion: Taken together, the arms compare as follows. Overall, Alvenor improves blood pressure control compared with Standard care.
section:
### Comparison of the arms

Standard care is the usual blood pressure treatment given to every patient. Alvenor is a once daily tablet that relaxes the walls of the blood vessels. The groups in this comparison were followed at the Oakfield Family Cohort.

Table 4. The measure for each arm, shown subset by subset.

| Older adults, Normal kidney function, Community clinic | Standard care | Blood pressure control | 423 | 700 |
